fields.description: Directory header word 0: first magic halfword of EEPROM block 0 ('Ha', 0x6148), compared against ROM constant on boot and rewritten from ROM on mismatch.
fields.evidence: FUN_0806ecd0 reads EEPROM block 0 via FUN_0806eff8 into local_28 and requires local_28 == DAT_0806edf4; baseline rev8-logical bytes 0-1 are 0x6148.
fields.name: directory_id_word0

fields.description: Directory header word 1: second magic halfword of EEPROM block 0 ('nd', 0x646e), compared against ROM constant on boot.
fields.evidence: FUN_0806ecd0 requires block-0 word1 (local_26) == DAT_0806edf8; baseline rev8-logical bytes 2-3 are 0x646e.
fields.name: directory_id_word1

fields.description: Directory header word 2: derived magic halfword ('He', 0x6548); boot init sets it to word1 + 0xDA, verified 0x646E + 0xDA = 0x6548 against baseline.
fields.evidence: FUN_0806ecd0 requires block-0 word2 (local_24) == DAT_0806edfc and its init path sets local_24 = local_26 + 0xDA; baseline bytes 4-5 are 0x6548.
fields.name: directory_id_word2

fields.description: Directory header word 3: record-count info, equal to record_count * 0x100 + 0x6C. Baseline 0x036C decodes to 3 records.
fields.evidence: FUN_0806ecd0 requires block-0 word3 (local_22) == (uint)*DAT_0806ee00 * 0x100 + 0x6C and its init path writes that formula; baseline 0x036C gives count 3, matching the 3-record read/write loops in FUN_0806ecd0.
fields.name: directory_record_count_info

fields.description: First data record 8-byte header word 0: write-sequence counter. Baseline 1 indicates the record was written once (fresh live-captured save).
fields.evidence: FUN_0806f164 builds the record header word0 (local_28) from the incremented sequence counter at DAT_0806f1c4 and writes the 8-byte header via FUN_0806f2d4; FUN_0806eec0 reads the 8-byte record header via FUN_0806eff8. Baseline rev8-logical bytes 8-9 are 0x0001.
fields.name: record_b_write_seq

fields.description: First data record header word 1: stored 16-bit checksum over the record bytes (custom byte-table/shift CRC in FUN_0806eec0 / FUN_0806f164, not a Schema v2 algorithm, so kept as a plain field; see SPEC.md). Baseline 0 over all-zero payload.
fields.evidence: FUN_0806eec0 recomputes a 16-bit checksum over the record bytes and requires header word1 (local_1e) to equal it, else sets error flag DAT_0806eff4 bit 1; FUN_0806f164 stores the computed value in header word1 (local_26). Baseline bytes 10-11 are 0x0000.
fields.name: record_b_header_crc16

fields.description: First 4 payload bytes of the first data record (carried inside the 8-byte EEPROM header as its tail words). All zero in the fresh baseline capture.
fields.evidence: FUN_0806eec0 copies record-header tail words local_1c/local_1a to record bytes 0-3 (file offsets 12-15) and FUN_0806f164 writes them back from record bytes 0-3 via FUN_0806f2d4; record size 0x98 passed by FUN_080002d4.
fields.name: record_b_data_first_words

fields.description: Remaining 144 payload bytes of the first data record (record offsets 4-151, file offsets 16-159). All zero in the fresh baseline capture; gameplay/config content would appear here once the game is played.
fields.evidence: FUN_0806eec0 loads record bytes 4+ via FUN_0806eff8(param_2 + 4, param_3 - 4, block + 1) and FUN_0806f164 stores them via FUN_0806f2d4(param_2 + 4, param_3 - 4, block + 1); main record size 0x98 passed by boot caller FUN_080002d4.
fields.name: record_b_data_bulk

magic_signatures.description: ASCII 'HandHe' directory magic (ROM constants DAT_0806edf4/edf8/edfc, verified in rev8-logical domain)

title: Green Eggs and Ham by Dr. Seuss (USA)
